movements.name: Recovery
movements.statement: The sources, read whole. The Recovery movement returns to the Qurʾān and its verses — systematic study, essence and paradigm — so that the Book may govern the argument rather than decorate it.

movements.name: Diagnosis
movements.statement: The present, named exactly. The Diagnosis movement examines the modern condition — the economy made absolute, justice imprisoned, society unsettled — and names the hand of the market wherever it finds it.

movements.name: Reconstruction
movements.statement: The programme. The Reconstruction movement sets out what is to be done — family planning, the control of epidemics, the prevention of disease, a destination and roadmap for community and country — several works carried in collaboration with the Government of India.

movements.name: Foundations
movements.statement: The teaching, and the letters. The Foundations movement grounds the argument — the universe from first principles, prayer and fasting read for their benefit, and the literary works of the house in Urdu and Hindi.

house.credo: A canon, recovered and reconstructed — read as one line.
